objective.maximize: PPO clipped surrogate - alpha * E_o KL(current || reference)
objective.reference_schedule: frozen for K inner data/update iterations, then refreshed from current

payoff.zero_decision_seat_handling: The flattened collector omits seats with no policy decisions. Their unobserved opposite payoff is fixed by the two-player zero-sum engine and has no gradient sample; payoff_audit records their count. Exact adjacent-pair sums are checked only when all seat episodes are populated.
